releases.name: GPT-5

announcement.title: Introducing GPT-5
announcement.quote: GPT‑5 is available to all users, with Plus subscribers getting more usage, and Pro subscribers getting access to GPT‑5 pro, a version with extended reasoning for even more comprehensive and accurate answers.

source.quote: It sets a new state of the art across math (94.6% on AIME 2025 without tools), real-world coding (74.9% on SWE-bench Verified, 88% on Aider Polyglot), multimodal understanding (84.2% on MMMU), and health (46.2% on HealthBench Hard)

source.quote: With GPT‑5 pro's extended reasoning, the model also sets a new SOTA on GPQA, scoring 88.4% without tools.

releases.notes: GPT-5 launched as a unified system (Instant/Thinking/Pro routed automatically); GPQA Diamond figure of 88.4% is specifically GPT-5 pro's extended-reasoning score, the highest in the family at launch. Launch date corroborated by extensive same-day press coverage (August 7, 2025).

releases.name: GPT-5.6 Sol

announcement.title: GPT-5.6: Frontier intelligence that scales with your ambition
announcement.quote: GPT‑5.6 is available starting today across ChatGPT, Codex, and the OpenAI API.

scores.note: First value (94.6%) is GPT-5.6 Sol; table also includes Terra, Luna, GPT-5.5 and third-party models for comparison.

releases.notes: GPT-5.6 ships as a family (Sol/Terra/Luna); Sol is the flagship recorded here. Launch post's Terminal-Bench score is versioned 2.1, not the basket's 2.0, so it is intentionally omitted for cross-release comparability. General-availability date (July 9, 2026) is not stated in the post's own text (which only carries later 'Update on ...' price-change notes); corroborated by Engadget (https://www.engadget.com/2210308/openai-rolls-out-gpt5-6-july-9/) and CNBC (https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/08/openai-expanding-gpt-5point6-ai-model-release-ending-government-limits.html).

releases.name: GPT-6 Astra

announcement.title: GPT-6 Astra: A new generation of intelligence
announcement.quote: GPT‑6 Astra is rolling out today to a limited set of organizations and over the coming days will become available to all ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise users, as well as through the OpenAI API, Microsoft Azure, and AWS Bedrock.

source.quote: GPQA Diamond tests graduate-level scientific reasoning in biology, chemistry, and physics. GPT‑6 Astra reaches a new high in the comparison shown at 96.0%.

releases.notes: Announced September 3, 2026 as a limited preview to trusted organizations; recorded date (September 4, 2026) is when OpenAI made a restricted version publicly available to paid ChatGPT users, per Al Jazeera (https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/9/4/openai-unveils-gpt-6-astra-amid-rising-scrutiny-and-safety) and CNBC (https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/03/open-ai-astra-gpt-6-cyber.html); not stated as a date in the announcement page's own body text. This is the newest confirmed OpenAI flagship as of this file's updated_at.
